subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v2 4/7] exportfs/mountd/exportd: get export features from the netlink policy

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch updates the nfs-utils package to retrieve export features from the netlink policy instead of reading them directly from /proc/fs/nfsd/export_features. It adds a new function, nfsd_export_policy_query(), which uses the CTRL_CMD_GETPOLICY dump to get the SET_REQS policy and fills a struct with the necessary information. The patch also introduces set_export_features() and nfsd_nl_load_export_features() functions to seed the export features from the policy. If netlink cannot answer, it still falls back to reading /proc/fs/nfsd/export_features.
